method: Selected once on 2026-10-21 by scripts/bench/odbench/select.ts (`bun run bench select`; `--check` rebuilds and compares); the committed file is frozen. Candidates (sqlite3-arm64, brotli): functions of the Open Decomp function index of the binary, minus import stubs (kind import_stub), unnamed and compiler-derived names (outlined .cold pieces and other names with a dot), names that occur more than once in the binary, names without exactly one top-level definition in the binary's source (sources.ts extractDefinitions: prototypes do not count; names defined on several conditional-compilation branches are ambiguous), and code_bytes outside [16, 32768] (larger functions dominate every total). code_bytes = sum of the instruction sizes of the function's compact disassembly (getFunction view disassembly), the value of index.tsv code_bytes in the CLI export; size buckets: small < 128 <= medium < 1024 <= large < 8192 <= huge. Exclusion counts: sqlite3-arm64: 2511 candidates after excluding 16 ambiguous_definition_in_source, 1 code_bytes_above_32768, 140 code_bytes_below_16, 1 compiler_derived_name, 130 compiler_outlined_cold, 30 import_stub, 702 no_definition_in_source, 352 unnamed; brotli: 15 candidates after excluding 1 compiler_outlined_cold, 48 import_stub. sqlite3-arm64: full = 100 drawn from the candidates other than QA functions, stratified small 25, medium 40, large 25, huge 10 (a bucket that runs out hands its remainder to medium), plus every function used by a question of scripts/bench/llm-tasks/questions.json (mapped by address, forced in regardless of size); quick = those QA functions + 20 drawn from the full draw (small 5, medium 8, large 5, huge 2). brotli: full = every candidate plus the QA functions; quick = the QA functions + 3 others. matrix: full = the 12 build-manifest functions of the 6 apple-clang21 symbol-bearing cells (macho-arm64, pe-x86_64, elf-x86_64 x O0, O2) and of the 3 llvm-clang23 -O2 stripped cells (stripped functions: name null, source from the symbol-bearing twin by address); quick = the 12 functions of elf-x86_64-apple-clang21-O2 symbols and of pe-x86_64-llvm-clang23-O2 stripped. crc32_z is defined on both branches of #ifdef ARMCRC32 in zlib crc32.c; the #else definition is active in every build (source.alternative 1; clang -E of each target defines neither W nor ARMCRC32). PRNG: mulberry32 seeded 20261021; pools sorted by va before drawing (partial Fisher-Yates per bucket in order small, medium, large, huge); one fresh generator per draw. Counts: quick: 68 functions (sqlite 34, brotli 10, matrix 24); by size small 29, medium 28, large 9, huge 2; per binary sqlite3-arm64 34, brotli 10, m-elf-x86_64-apple-clang21-O2-sym 12, m-pe-x86_64-llvm-clang23-O2-strip 12. full: 237 functions (sqlite 114, brotli 15, matrix 108); by size small 104, medium 96, large 33, huge 4; per binary sqlite3-arm64 114, brotli 15, m-macho-arm64-apple-clang21-O0-sym 12, m-pe-x86_64-apple-clang21-O0-sym 12, m-elf-x86_64-apple-clang21-O0-sym 12, m-macho-arm64-apple-clang21-O2-sym 12, m-pe-x86_64-apple-clang21-O2-sym 12, m-elf-x86_64-apple-clang21-O2-sym 12, m-macho-arm64-llvm-clang23-O2-strip 12, m-pe-x86_64-llvm-clang23-O2-strip 12, m-elf-x86_64-llvm-clang23-O2-strip 12.
